other_conditions: The applicant must have worked in building and construction for at least 90 days in a given year.
The applicant must not be a member of any other Welfare Fund established under any law.
The applicant must be the nominee of a deceased registered member of the Board.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹1,50,000 for permanent total disability, ₹80,000 for loss of one limb or eye, and ₹40,000 for other permanent disabilities caused by an accident.
